title: Hero tidy: ⋯ starts Link to, Claim, Add to a trip; journeys can be linked; the stock photo's details see-through; Explore's place in one line
why: Jason, 2026-11-20, on the place page and Explore: "should start with Link to, then Claim, Add to Trip, then the rest of the list of options"; "when active the link icon on the page should disappear"; "Stock photo pop-up should be transparent enough to see the image bg slightly while not losing readability"; "The location isnt handled well visually" (Explore's banner); "The rest is obvious" (the hub's stray text). His pop-up answers, 2026-11-20: Approve; journeys' Link: "Fix it here"; same-named areas: "This seems to be a crawler, workflow issue, because the page should show what is properly assigned to that area based on its funnel level" (the merge taken out; the data is the area data plan's).

changes.what: ⋯ on a listing, place or landmark starts Link to, Claim, Add to a trip, then the rest; Claim greyed with why where there's nothing to claim
The page's Link icon steps aside while ⋯ is open, and comes back when it closes
The stock photo's details: 80% opaque, the photo blurred behind; the words no longer repeat "Representative photo"
Explore's default-place offer is one slim line with ×
The hub's stray "// ··· (2026-11-19)" text is gone
A published journey can be linked: its Link icon (on its page and its card) now works, and it shows under your linked places as "A journey you linked"; a draft or hidden journey can't be linked
FAQ: What's under ⋯ (the new order); Can I link a journey?
